references.text: Eljasaph, son of Deuel, is mentioned again as the leader of the tribe of Gad during the organization of the camp.
Eljasaph, son of Deuel, brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Gad at the dedication of the altar.
Eljasaph, son of Deuel, leads the army of the tribe of Gad during the wilderness journey.
The tribe of Gad traces its origin to Gad, son of Jacob and Zilpah.
Gad's sons are mentioned among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob.
